units.text: INT. NIGHT BUS - MOVING - NIGHT
Route 9, last run.
Sodium light strobes through rain-streaked windows.
Three passengers and a driver nobody can see.
CLOSE ON a gym bag on the back seat.
Zipper half open.
Cash.
JUNO MARCHETTI, 30s, rumpled blazer, sits clutching that bag like a toddler.
Beside the aisle, SAM OKONKWO-REID, late 20s, they/them, buzzcut and a vintage bomber jacket, eats cold fries and watches Juno with a grin.
Across from them, BERNIE KOWALCZYK, 60s, big coat, bigger moustache, sleeps.
You've been gripping that bag since Harlow Street. Are you carrying a baby or a bomb?
units.name: SAM

units.text: It's a gym bag.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: Sweetheart, nobody sweats that much.
units.name: SAM

units.text: Juno laughs too loud.
Bernie stirs.
Both of them freeze, then relax when he snores again.
Look I need you to stop being charming at me. It's not helping
units.name: JUNO

units.text: Charming is my only setting. They gave me one setting at the factory.
units.name: SAM

units.text: ANGLE ON the bus mirror.
The driver's eyes, flat, watching.
The bus LURCHES over a pothole.
The bag tips.
A brick of cash slides into the aisle.
Juno dives, Sam dives, they crack heads, the bag goes sideways, fries everywhere.
Ow! Ow, ow
units.name: JUNO

units.text: That was my face!
units.name: SAM

units.text: Kids. Keep it down. Some of us have been robbed before and we're trying to rest.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: Silence.
Juno and Sam stare at him.
Relax. I'm retired. I don't care whose money it is.
units.name: BERNIE

units.text: INSERT - Sam's phone screen: a news alert.
BANK ON FERRIS AVE ROBBED, TWO SUSPECTS AT LARGE.
Sam turns the screen to Juno slowly.
Juno exhales, sinks into the seat.
Okay. Okay. Plan B.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: We had a plan A?
units.name: SAM

units.text: Barely.
units.name: JUNO

units.text: BACK TO SCENE.
The bus slows.
Blue light flickers ahead on the wet road.
This is the last time the three of them will be calm.
Well. It's been a pleasure being your accomplice.
units.name: SAM

units.text: Bernie pats the bag, closes his eye again.
Wake me at the courthouse.
units.name: BERNIE
